duplicate_encoder_out: duplicate encoder output tensors for beam search by repeating across the beam size dimension
generate_step_with_prob: generate the next token step with softmax probabilities and argmax indices from model output
assign_single_value_byte: assign a single scalar value to selected positions in a byte tensor using a mask
assign_multi_value_long: assign multiple values to selected positions in a long tensor using row-wise index offsets
convert_tokens: convert a list of token IDs to a space-separated string using a token dictionary
